title: Chapter 1460 - 8: Unity
content:
Chapter 1460 - 8: Unity

Chapter 1460 - 8: Unity

After surpassing the Dark Star Lord, Lin Yuan didn't slack off and continued climbing with full strength.

Although he held an absolute lead on this white jade step, what about the other white jade steps?

It should be known that the white jade steps formed by the transcendence power this time total thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three.

The competition pressure on the white jade step where Lin Yuan was, wasn't big; besides him, the strongest were Legendary Lords like Dark Star Lord, Lord Zhuo He, who had survived two billion five to six hundred million calamities.

On other white jade steps, the strongest might have power reaching the level of surviving two billion eight to nine hundred million

calamities, or even surpassing three billion calamities like Fantian Lord and Lord Haotian.

Although Lin Yuan's strength was terrifying, in climbing the white jade steps, strength was only one factor.

Who knows what means these ancient Legendary Lords who had lived through endless ages and accumulated tremendous might have?

These ancient Legendary Lords were trapped at their current realm for an unknown length of time; once they slightly received guidance from the white jade steps and the direction of evolution for their own Chaotic Origin Dao, their climbing speed would definitely not be much weaker than Lin Yuan.

Of course, Lin Yuan believed in his Against-Heaven's Understanding. Perhaps, in a short period, those ancient Legendary Lords could slightly surpass Lin Yuan with their own substantial accumulation. But as the timeline extends... no matter how immense the

accumulation, it will eventually run out one day, while Lin Yuan's Against-Heaven's Understanding was inexhaustible.

"Hmm?"

As he continued climbing, the white jade steps guided Lin Yuan's direction for cultivation, and countless inspirations and insights collided in his mind.

"Innate Fifth Tai..."

Lin Yuan murmured, within the depths of his eyes, the forces of Taiyi, Taichu, Taishi, Taisu intertwined, faintly resonating with Lin Yuan's Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

The four forces of Tai harmoniously integrated with the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

"Taiji is the fifth Tai in the Innate Five Great."

Lin Yuan's eyes shone brightly.

To be precise, the fifth Tai of the Innate Five Great can be nurtured from the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

"I see."

Lin Yuan mused thoughtfully.

In the fourth Origin World, watching the Origin World during its nascent period, he comprehended the foundation of "Innate Five Great", originally Lin Yuan thought "Innate Five Great" completely originated from that Origin World.

Now it seems the essence of "Innate Five Great" lies within himself and the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao he masters.

The forces of Taiyi, Taichu, Taishi, Taisu, Taiji represent different stages, with Taiji symbolizing the final stage.

And restoring the other four forces of Tai with Taiji Power is entirely a matter of subtle influence.

Even without the experiences of the fourth Origin World, through

comprehending the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao and realizing its Taiji Power, one day he will also grasp the other four forces of Tai.

It's just a matter of a longer time.

"Next, the direction of cultivation is nurturing "Tai' Power from the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao."

Lin Yuan thinks quickly in his mind.

The "Tai' Power here is not the same as the Taiji Power that Lin Yuan mastered before becoming a temporal life.

The former emphasizes "Tai', and is the power of Tai in the "Innate Five

Great".

"If not for climbing the white jade steps, I don't know how long it would take to nurture "Tai' Power."

Lin Yuan smiles.

The white jade steps pointed out the direction of evolution for the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, the stronger the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao becomes, the easier it is to nurture "Tai' Power.

...

Just as Lin Yuan continued climbing the white jade steps.

In infinite dimensional dimensions, many Legendary Lords' eyes turned towards the white jade steps where Lin Yuan was.

On the thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three white jade steps, battles between the Legendary Lords occur every moment. But involving Legendary Lords like Lord Zhuo He who survived two billion five hundred million calamities was rare, especially when Lord Zhuo He was effortlessly crushed by Lin Yuan.

In a vast space-time.

Several figures sat cross-legged.

These figures were Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, Lord Wan Xiang, and

other Legendary Lords who survived three billion calamities. In the current space-time of infinite dimensional dimensions, there are only a few such strong individuals, and they are all known to each

other.

This time, with the appearance of white jade steps, Lord Haotian and several Legendary Lords sent an avatar to this place.

At least for now, several Legendary Lords are far ahead on their respective white jade steps and don't have competitive relations

momentarily.

"Haotian, have you seen the battle scenes of the Galaxy Lord?"

Lord Wan Xiang glanced at Lord Haotian and asked.

When Lin Yuan eliminated Lord Zhuo He, many Legendary Lords

below witnessed it, naturally, the related scenes spread.

Not to mention, even Lord Zhuo He himself could spread scenes of his confrontation with the Galaxy Lord.

"I have." Lord Haotian opened his eyes and nodded, saying, "I'm not a

match for that Galaxy."

As one of the renowned 'Double Heavens, having Lord Haotian

actively admit he's not a match is astonishing.

"You're not a match?"

Lord Wan Xiang's expression changed.

Comparatively to the strength and methods currently shown by the

Galaxy Lord and those displayed by Lord Haotian.

Lord Haotian indeed wasn't a match.

But as Legendary Lords, they certainly have cards and backup plans

never revealed.

Even if the Galaxy Lord has unrevealed cards, shouldn't Lord Haotian not so easily admit defeat?

An outsider's opinion that Lord Haotian wasn't a match for the Galaxy Lord differs from Lord Haotian himself considering not being a match.
